Classic Brooklyn charm meets modern updates in this beautifully renovated, sun-filled railroad-style apartment. Situated on the top (4th) floor, this spacious and airy home offers a flexible layout, ideal as a one-bedroom with a dedicated home office or a two-bedroom.

Layout Note: The flexible layout features two separate entrances, allowing access through the hallway without passing through the smaller bedroom. Ideally suited for use as a one-bedroom with a home office, this apartment could be also used as a two bedroom.

The recently updated bathroom features a beautifully reglazed classic clawfoot-style bathtub, combining vintage charm with modern finishes.

* Flexible railroad-style layout

* New kitchen with stainless steel appliances
* Dishwasher and over-the-range microwave
* Spacious eat-in kitchen with abundant cabinetry
* King-size primary bedroom
* Heat and hot water included
-Small pets allowed with approval
